# Issue triage

Use this guidance for bug review, backlog cleanup, and issue summarization.

## Required behavior

- separate confirmed bugs, needs-repro, needs-info, security-sensitive items, and enhancement ideas
- call out severity, user impact, and likely owner when possible
- identify what can be delegated safely versus what needs human decision-making
- do not close or relabel issues automatically unless the repository explicitly allows it
- security-sensitive reports should be escalated for human review, not summarized publicly with exploit details
